name: Ramp
text: Add a visible server-side skip link at the top of every page. It’s the only reliable way to let keyboard users bypass repetitive blocks like navigation menus. The trade-off is a small extra server-side render, but it’s worth it for true accessibility.

name: Reader
text: A visible server-side skip link can disrupt the visual layout and flow, creating confusion for users who do not rely on assistive technologies. Instead, consider enhancing the existing client-side skip link to work effectively, ensuring it is functional even when JavaScript is slow or disabled. To settle the argument, testing both methods with actual users could determine which solution truly improves accessibility without compromising the user experience.
